[TARGET CONTRACT]
1. Server batch runtime fields are server-authoritative and never accepted from Board autosave.
2. Review actions from Telegram and browser share one monotonic review revision.
3. A stale browser snapshot cannot undo a newer Telegram action.
4. A stale Telegram callback cannot undo a newer browser action.
5. Canceling/replacing review status never clears waiting/queued badges.
6. Status polling is read-only and cannot trigger whole-Board autosave.
7. New completed scenes enter needs_review once, without oscillation.

001319:   if (!scene || typeof scene !== 'object') return 0

001326:   if (['bad', 'poor', 'reject', 'rejected', 'плохое', 'плохая'].includes(reviewStatusV132T)) score += 320
001327:   if (scene.video_result || scene.videoResult) score += 300
001328:   if (scene.video_job_id || scene.videoJobId || scene.video_status_endpoint || scene.videoStatusEndpoint) score += 100
001329:   const status = String(scene.video_status || scene.videoStatus || '').toLowerCase()

001768: function boardLocalReviewEventWinsV213L(localScene = {}, serverScene = {}) {
001769:   const localEvent = boardReviewEventInfoV213L(localScene)
001770:   if (!localEvent.has) return false
001771:   const serverEvent = boardReviewEventInfoV213L(serverScene)
001772:   if (!serverEvent.has) return true
001773: 
001774:   const sameVideoV216P = boardReviewSameVideoV216P(localScene, serverScene)
001775:   // Human decision is semantic authority for the same generated asset.
001776:   // Do this BEFORE timestamp comparison because completed-batch replay creates
001777:   // a newer system timestamp on every refresh.
001778:   if (sameVideoV216P && localEvent.manual && !serverEvent.manual) return true
001779:   if (sameVideoV216P && !localEvent.manual && serverEvent.manual) return false
001780: 
001781:   if (localEvent.atMs && serverEvent.atMs) return localEvent.atMs >= serverEvent.atMs
001782:   if (sameVideoV216P && localEvent.manual && !serverEvent.manual) return true
001783:   return false
001784: }

002847: function applyCompletedJobsToBoard(boardData = {}, context = {}) {
002848:   const jobs = readAvaCompletedJobs()
002849:   if (!jobs.length || !Array.isArray(boardData.scenes)) {
002850:     return { board: boardData, usedKeys: [] }
002851:   }
002852: 
002853:   const usedKeys = []
002854:   const matchingJobs = []
002855:   for (const job of jobs) {
002856:     const reason = boardCompletedJobSkipReason(job, context)
002857:     if (reason) {
002858:       const key = job.key || job.jobId || job.job_id || ''
002859:       if (key) usedKeys.push(key)
002860:       console.warn('[BOARD JOB COMPLETED SKIP]', {
002861:         reason,
002862:         jobId: job.jobId || job.job_id || '',
002863:         projectId: job.projectId || job.project_id || '',
002864:         sceneId: job.sceneId || job.scene_id || '',
002865:       })
002866:       continue
002867:     }
002868:     matchingJobs.push(job)
002869:   }
002870:   if (!matchingJobs.length) return { board: boardData, usedKeys }
002871: 
002872:   let changed = false
002873:   const scenes = boardData.scenes.map((scene) => {
002874:     const sceneId = scene?.id || scene?.scene_id
002875:     const sceneJobs = matchingJobs.filter((job) => asText(job.sceneId || job.scene_id || job.data?.sceneId || job.data?.scene_id) === asText(sceneId))
002876:     if (!sceneJobs.length) return scene
002877: 
002878:     let nextScene = scene
002879:     for (const job of sceneJobs) {
002880:       const patch = completedJobPatch(job)
002881:       if (!patch) continue
002882: 
002883:       nextScene = canonicalizeBoardSceneMediaRefs({
002884:         ...nextScene,
002885:         ...patch,
002886:       })
002887:       usedKeys.push(job.key)
002888:       changed = true
002889:     }
002890: 
002891:     return nextScene
002892:   })
002893: 
002894:   if (!changed) return { board: boardData, usedKeys }
002895: 
002896:   return {
002897:     board: {
002898:       ...boardData,
002899:       scenes,
002900:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
002901:     },
002902:     usedKeys,
002903:   }
002904: }

002906: function asArray(value) {
002907:   return Array.isArray(value) ? value : []
002908: }
002909: 
002910: function isPlainObject(value) {
002911:   return Boolean(value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value))
002912: }
002913: 
002914: function asSceneArray(value) {
002915:   return asArray(value).filter((scene) => isPlainObject(scene))
002916: }
002917: 
002918: function asText(value) {
002919:   return String(value || '').trim()
002920: }
002921: 
002922: function toNumber(value, fallback = 0) {
002923:   const parsed = Number(value)
002924:   return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : fallback
002925: }
002926: 
002927: function formatTime(seconds) {
002928:   const safe = Math.max(0, toNumber(seconds, 0))
002929:   const mins = String(Math.floor(safe / 60)).padStart(2, '0')
002930:   const secs = String(Math.floor(safe % 60)).padStart(2, '0')
002931:   const ms = String(Math.floor((safe - Math.floor(safe)) * 1000)).padStart(3, '0')
002932:   return `${mins}:${secs}.${ms}`
002933: }
002934: 
002935: function formatRange(scene) {
002936:   if (!scene) return '00:00.000 → 00:00.000'
002937:   return `${formatTime(scene.start)} → ${formatTime(scene.end)}`
002938: }
002939: 
002940: function durationOf(scene) {
002941:   return Math.max(0, toNumber(scene.end, 0) - toNumber(scene.start, 0))
002942: }

002944: // AVA_BOARD_TIMING_DURATION_LOCK_V38:
002945: // Duration lock belongs to the scene data, not to the route used to open Board.
002946: // A Timing-imported scene must keep its timing duration even after F5, direct Board entry,
002947: // cross-computer restore, or notification-based navigation.
002948: function formatBoardDurationShort(seconds) {
002949:   const value = Math.max(0, toNumber(seconds, 0))
002950:   if (!value) return '0'
002951:   return value.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, '')
002952: }

010117:   function syncServerBatchRuntimeOverlayV209R(batchStatusData = {}, boardData = {}, source = '') {
010118:     // AVA_BOARD_SERVER_BATCH_RUNTIME_OVERLAY_V209R:
010119:     // Convert the backend batch status into a browser-only runtime map. This does not
010120:     // persist to ava_db.json; it only paints UI badges while the server owns generation.
010121:     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
010122:     const batch = batchStatusData?.batch || batchStatusData?.board_video_batch || boardData?.board_video_batch || boardData?.boardVideoBatch || {}
010123:     const batchStatus = String(batch?.status || batch?.batch_status || '').toLowerCase()
010124:     const activeStatuses = new Set(['queued', 'running', 'starting', 'preparing', 'submitting', 'processing'])
010125:     const terminalStatuses = new Set(['', 'idle', 'finished', 'finished_with_errors', 'failed', 'error', 'canceled', 'cancelled', 'stopped', 'done', 'completed', 'success'])
010126:     const activeSceneId = asText(batch?.activeSceneId || batch?.active_scene_id)
010127:     const activeJobId = asText(batch?.activeJobId || batch?.active_job_id)
010128:     const activeEndpoint = asText(batch?.activeStatusEndpoint || batch?.active_status_endpoint)
010129:     const waitingIds = asArray(batch?.waitingSceneIds || batch?.waiting_scene_ids || batch?.queuedSceneIds || batch?.queued_scene_ids)
010130:       .map((id) => asText(id)).filter(Boolean)
010131:     const completedIds = new Set(asArray(batch?.completedSceneIds || batch?.completed_scene_ids).map((id) => asText(id)).filter(Boolean))
010132:     const failedIds = new Set(asArray(batch?.failedSceneIds || batch?.failed_scene_ids).map((id) => asText(id)).filter(Boolean))
010133: 
010134:     const hasLiveBatch = Boolean(
010135:       activeStatuses.has(batchStatus) ||
010136:       activeSceneId || activeJobId || activeEndpoint || waitingIds.length
010137:     )
010138: 
010139:     const currentMap = window.__AVA_BOARD_SERVER_BATCH_RUNTIME_V209R__ || {}
010140:     let nextMap = { ...currentMap }
010141:     let changed = false
010142:     const setEntry = (sceneId, status, extra = {}) => {
010143:       const safeSceneId = asText(sceneId)
010144:       if (!safeSceneId) return
010145:       const nextEntry = {
010146:         ...(nextMap[safeSceneId] || {}),
010147:         sceneId: safeSceneId,
010148:         status,
010149:         batchId: asText(batch?.batchId || batch?.batch_id || nextMap[safeSceneId]?.batchId || ''),
010150:         jobId: asText(extra.jobId || nextMap[safeSceneId]?.jobId || ''),
010151:         statusEndpoint: asText(extra.statusEndpoint || nextMap[safeSceneId]?.statusEndpoint || ''),
010152:         queuePosition: Number(extra.queuePosition || 0) || 0,
010153:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
010154:         source: source || 'server_batch_runtime_overlay_v209r',
010155:       }
010156:       const prev = JSON.stringify(nextMap[safeSceneId] || {})
010157:       const cur = JSON.stringify(nextEntry)
010158:       nextMap[safeSceneId] = nextEntry
010159:       if (prev !== cur) changed = true
010160:     }
010161:     const clearEntry = (sceneId) => {
010162:       const safeSceneId = asText(sceneId)
010163:       if (safeSceneId && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(nextMap, safeSceneId)) {
010164:         delete nextMap[safeSceneId]
010165:         changed = true
010166:       }
010167:     }
010168: 
010169:     if (hasLiveBatch) {
010170:       // AVA_BOARD_BATCH_LIVE_SET_REPLACES_RUNTIME_V210A: the live server-batch set is authoritative.
010171:       // Runtime overlay used to be merge-only, so old active scenes stayed busy
010172:       // until the entire batch finished. Clear any same-batch/global batch entry
010173:       // that is no longer active or waiting.
010174:       const liveServerBatchIdsV210A = new Set([activeSceneId, ...waitingIds]
010175:         .map((id) => asText(id))
010176:         .filter(Boolean))
010177:       const batchIdV210A = asText(batch?.batchId || batch?.batch_id || '')
010178:       Object.entries(nextMap || {}).forEach(([sceneId, entry]) => {
010179:         const safeSceneId = asText(sceneId)
010180:         if (!safeSceneId) return
010181:         const entryStatus = String(entry?.status || '').toLowerCase()
010182:         const entryBatchId = asText(entry?.batchId || entry?.batch_id || '')
010183:         const entrySource = String(entry?.source || '').toLowerCase()
010184:         const sameBatch = Boolean(batchIdV210A && entryBatchId && entryBatchId === batchIdV210A)
010185:         const batchRuntimeSource = Boolean(
010186:           entrySource.includes('server_batch') ||
010187:           entrySource.includes('frontend_global_runtime_pin') ||
010188:           entrySource.includes('server_batch_accepted_runtime') ||
010189:           entrySource.includes('early_submitting') ||
010190:           entrySource.includes('runtime_v136i')
010191:         )
010192:         if ((sameBatch || batchRuntimeSource) && isVideoBusyStatus(entryStatus) && !liveServerBatchIdsV210A.has(safeSceneId)) {
010193:           clearEntry(safeSceneId)
010194:         }
010195:       })
010196:       // AVA_BOARD_COMPLETED_NOT_BUSY_OVERLAY_V209T: clear completed scenes first so old runtime busy badges cannot survive.
010197:       completedIds.forEach((sceneId) => clearEntry(sceneId))
010198:       if (activeSceneId) setEntry(activeSceneId, 'running', { jobId: activeJobId, statusEndpoint: activeEndpoint })
010199:       waitingIds.forEach((sceneId, index) => {
010200:         if (sceneId === activeSceneId) return
010201:         const waitingStatusV209X = (!activeSceneId && ['preparing', 'submitting', 'starting'].includes(batchStatus))
010202:           ? 'submitting'
010203:           : 'queued'
010204:         setEntry(sceneId, waitingStatusV209X, { queuePosition: index + 1 })
010205:       })
010206:       failedIds.forEach((sceneId) => setEntry(sceneId, 'error'))
010207:       // AVA_BOARD_COMPLETED_NOT_BUSY_OVERLAY_V209T:
010208:       // A server-batch completed scene is no longer busy. Do NOT keep it as
010209:       // runtime "running" while waiting for React board state to see the fresh
010210:       // video ref; that makes completed scenes pile up as "видео делается".
010211:       // The backend already wrote/registered the result, and the normal Board
010212:       // snapshot/review merge will show "видео готово" or "посмотри".
010213:       completedIds.forEach((sceneId) => {
010214:         clearEntry(sceneId)
010215:       })
010216:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.__AVA_BOARD_SERVER_VIDEO_BATCH_ACTIVE__ = true
010217:     } else if (terminalStatuses.has(batchStatus)) {
010218:       // Clear all entries for this batch; keep unrelated map entries untouched just in case.
010219:       const idsToClear = new Set([
010220:         activeSceneId,
010221:         ...waitingIds,
010222:         ...Array.from(completedIds),
010223:         ...Array.from(failedIds),
010224:       ].map((id) => asText(id)).filter(Boolean))
010225:       console.log('[BOARD TERMINAL BATCH CLEARS OWN SCENES ONLY V216L]', {
010226:         batchStatus,
010227:         activeSceneId,
010228:         waitingIds,
010229:         sceneIds: Array.from(idsToClear),
010230:         preservedRuntimeSceneIds: Object.keys(currentMap).filter((sceneId) => !idsToClear.has(sceneId)),
010231:       })
010232:       idsToClear.forEach(clearEntry)
010233:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.__AVA_BOARD_SERVER_VIDEO_BATCH_ACTIVE__ = false
010234:     }
010235: 
010236:     if (changed) {

004443: # AVA_BOARD_BAD_REVIEW_SERVER_BATCH_V132A
004444: # Board review flow:
004445: #   bad          -> red mark: regenerate this video, even if old video refs exist.
004446: #   needs_review -> orange mark after regeneration: user must watch and accept/mark bad again.
004447: def _board_batch_review_status(scene: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
004448:     if not isinstance(scene, dict):
004449:         return ""
004450:     raw = str(
004451:         scene.get("video_review_status")
004452:         or scene.get("videoReviewStatus")
004453:         or scene.get("review_status")
004454:         or scene.get("reviewStatus")
004455:         or ""
004456:     ).strip().lower()
004457:     if raw in {"bad", "poor", "reject", "rejected", "плохое", "плохая"}:
004458:         return "bad"
004459:     if raw in {"needs_review", "review", "check", "посмотри", "на проверку"}:
004460:         return "needs_review"
004461:     return ""
004462: 
004463: 
004464: def _board_batch_scene_has_bad_review(scene: dict[str, Any] | None) -> bool:
004465:     return _board_batch_review_status(scene) == "bad"

004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

000099: # AVA_BOARD_VIDEO_JOB_PERSIST_V62:
000100: # Board video jobs used to live only in process memory. If the backend was restarted
000101: # while Comfy was still rendering, the UI kept polling a job that the backend had
000102: # forgotten. Persist a lightweight sanitized copy into storage/jobs so status polling
000103: # can continue after backend restart and still collect Comfy outputs by promptId.
000104: def _board_video_job_sanitize(value: Any, depth: int = 0) -> Any:
000105:     if depth > 8:
000106:         return "[omitted_depth]"
000107:     if isinstance(value, dict):
000108:         result: dict[str, Any] = {}
000109:         for key, item in value.items():
000110:             key_text = str(key)
000111:             key_lower = key_text.lower()
000112:             if "dataurl" in key_lower or "data_url" in key_lower:
000113:                 result[key_text] = "[omitted_data_url]"
000114:                 continue
000115:             result[key_text] = _board_video_job_sanitize(item, depth + 1)
000116:         return result
000117:     if isinstance(value, list):
000118:         return [_board_video_job_sanitize(item, depth + 1) for item in value[:200]]
000119:     if isinstance(value, str):
000120:         if value.startswith("data:"):
000121:             return "[omitted_data_url]"
000122:         if len(value) > 12000:
000123:             return value[:12000] + "...[truncated]"
000124:     return value

004732: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004733: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004734: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004735: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck

004737: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004738:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004739:     if not raw:
004740:         return None
004741:     try:
004742:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004743:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004744:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004745:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

004737: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004738:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004739:     if not raw:
004740:         return None
004741:     try:
004742:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004743:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004744:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004745:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

004732: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004733: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004734: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004735: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004736: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004737: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004738:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004739:     if not raw:
004740:         return None
004741:     try:
004742:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004743:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004744:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004745:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

004732: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004733: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004734: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004735: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004736: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004737: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004738:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004739:     if not raw:
004740:         return None
004741:     try:
004742:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004743:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004744:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004745:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

004732: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004733: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004734: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004735: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004736: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004737: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004738:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004739:     if not raw:
004740:         return None
004741:     try:
004742:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004743:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004744:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004745:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

000099: # AVA_BOARD_VIDEO_JOB_PERSIST_V62:
000100: # Board video jobs used to live only in process memory. If the backend was restarted
000101: # while Comfy was still rendering, the UI kept polling a job that the backend had
000102: # forgotten. Persist a lightweight sanitized copy into storage/jobs so status polling
000103: # can continue after backend restart and still collect Comfy outputs by promptId.
000104: def _board_video_job_sanitize(value: Any, depth: int = 0) -> Any:
000105:     if depth > 8:
000106:         return "[omitted_depth]"
000107:     if isinstance(value, dict):
000108:         result: dict[str, Any] = {}
000109:         for key, item in value.items():
000110:             key_text = str(key)
000111:             key_lower = key_text.lower()
000112:             if "dataurl" in key_lower or "data_url" in key_lower:
000113:                 result[key_text] = "[omitted_data_url]"
000114:                 continue
000115:             result[key_text] = _board_video_job_sanitize(item, depth + 1)
000116:         return result
000117:     if isinstance(value, list):
000118:         return [_board_video_job_sanitize(item, depth + 1) for item in value[:200]]
000119:     if isinstance(value, str):
000120:         if value.startswith("data:"):
000121:             return "[omitted_data_url]"
000122:         if len(value) > 12000:
000123:             return value[:12000] + "...[truncated]"
000124:     return value
000125: 
000126: 
000127: def _board_video_job_store(job_id: str, job: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
000128:     safe_job_id = str(job_id or job.get("jobId") or job.get("job_id") or "").strip()
000129:     if not safe_job_id or not isinstance(job, dict):
000130:         return
000131:     job["jobId"] = job.get("jobId") or safe_job_id

004732: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004733: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004734: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004735: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004736: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004737: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004738:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004739:     if not raw:
004740:         return None
004741:     try:
004742:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004743:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004744:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004745:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004746:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004747:         return parsed
004748:     except Exception:
004749:         return None

007269:     # emotion + 2-4 concrete sounds + no background.
007270:     prompt_text = str(raw_prompt or "").strip()
007271:     return len(prompt_text) <= 240

007228:     base_text = str(base or "").strip()

000262: def _ffprobe_duration(path: Path) -> float:

000265:         return 0.0

000185: def _resolve_static_asset_path(value: str | None) -> Path:
000186:     raw = str(value or '').strip()
000187:     if not raw:
000188:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail='Missing static asset url')
000189:     try:
000190:         parsed = urlparse(raw)
000191:         raw_path = parsed.path if parsed.scheme in {'http', 'https'} else raw
000192:     except Exception:

000194: 
000195:     raw_path = unquote(raw_path.split('?', 1)[0].split('#', 1)[0])
000196:     marker = '/static/assets/'
000197:     if marker in raw_path:
000198:         rel = raw_path.split(marker, 1)[1]
000199:     elif raw_path.startswith('static/assets/'):
000200:         rel = raw_path[len('static/assets/'):]
000201:     else:
000202:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail='Only /static/assets media can be registered')
000203: 
000204:     static_root = get_settings().static_path.resolve()
000205:     candidate = (static_root / 'assets' / Path(rel)).resolve()
000206:     try:
000207:         candidate.relative_to(static_root)
000208:     except ValueError:
000209:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail='Invalid static asset path')
000210:     if not candidate.exists() or not candidate.is_file():
000211:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail='Static asset file not found')
000212:     return candidate

004211: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004212: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004213: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004214: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004215: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004216: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004217:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004218:     if not raw:
004219:         return None
004220:     try:
004221:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004222:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004223:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004224:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004225:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004226:         return parsed
004227:     except Exception:
004228:         return None

004211: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004212: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004213: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004214: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004215: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004216: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004217:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004218:     if not raw:
004219:         return None
004220:     try:
004221:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004222:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004223:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004224:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004225:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004226:         return parsed
004227:     except Exception:
004228:         return None

004211: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004212: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004213: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004214: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004215: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004216: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004217:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004218:     if not raw:
004219:         return None
004220:     try:
004221:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004222:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004223:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004224:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004225:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004226:         return parsed
004227:     except Exception:
004228:         return None

004211: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004212: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004213: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004214: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004215: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004216: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004217:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004218:     if not raw:
004219:         return None
004220:     try:
004221:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004222:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004223:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004224:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004225:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004226:         return parsed
004227:     except Exception:
004228:         return None

004211: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004212: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004213: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004214: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004215: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004216: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004217:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004218:     if not raw:
004219:         return None
004220:     try:
004221:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004222:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004223:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004224:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004225:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004226:         return parsed
004227:     except Exception:
004228:         return None
004229: 
004230: 
004231: def _board_batch_clear_stale_manual_scene_locks_v200a(
004232:     project_id: str,
004233:     board_data: dict[str, Any],
004234:     *,
004235:     max_age_sec: int = 90,
004236:     reason: str = "stale_manual_start_without_job_v200a",
004237: ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[str]]:
004238:     scenes = board_data.get("scenes") if isinstance(board_data.get("scenes"), list) else []
004239:     if not scenes:
004240:         return board_data, []
004241:     now_dt = datetime.utcnow()
004242:     transient = {"starting", "preparing", "submitting", "running", "processing", "queued_no_prompt_id"}
004243:     changed = False
004244:     cleared: list[str] = []
004245:     next_scenes: list[Any] = []
004246:     for scene in scenes:
004247:         if not isinstance(scene, dict):
004248:             next_scenes.append(scene)
004249:             continue
004250:         status = str(scene.get("video_status") or scene.get("videoStatus") or "").strip().lower()
004251:         has_job = bool(
004252:             str(scene.get("video_job_id") or scene.get("videoJobId") or "").strip() or
004253:             str(scene.get("video_status_endpoint") or scene.get("videoStatusEndpoint") or "").strip() or
004254:             str(scene.get("server_batch_job_id") or scene.get("serverBatchJobId") or "").strip() or
004255:             str(scene.get("server_batch_status_endpoint") or scene.get("serverBatchStatusEndpoint") or "").strip()
004256:         )
004257:         if status not in transient or has_job:
004258:             next_scenes.append(scene)
004259:             continue
004260:         stamp = None
004261:         for key in ("video_started_at", "videoStartedAt", "video_updated_at", "videoUpdatedAt", "updatedAt", "updated_at"):
004262:             stamp = _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(scene.get(key))
004263:             if stamp is not None:
004264:                 break
004265:         age = 10**9 if stamp is None else (now_dt - stamp).total_seconds()
004266:         if age < max_age_sec:
004267:             next_scenes.append(scene)
004268:             continue
004269:         scene_id = _board_batch_scene_id(scene)
004270:         has_video = _board_batch_scene_has_video(scene)
004271:         patched = dict(scene)
004272:         patched.update({

002793:         item.get("audio_api_path") or item.get("audioApiPath") or
002794:         item.get("manual_lipsync_audio_api_path") or item.get("manualLipSyncAudioApiPath") or
002795:         item.get("audio_url") or item.get("audioUrl") or
002796:         item.get("url") or item.get("src") or ""
002797:     ).strip()
002798:     asset_id = str(
002799:         item.get("audio_asset_id") or item.get("audioAssetId") or
002800:         item.get("manual_lipsync_audio_asset_id") or item.get("manualLipSyncAudioAssetId") or
002801:         item.get("asset_id") or item.get("assetId") or ""
002802:     ).strip()
002803:     parsed_asset_id = _asset_id_from_text(source_ref) or ""
002804:     if not asset_id and parsed_asset_id:
002805:         asset_id = parsed_asset_id
002806:     if asset_id and not source_ref:
002807:         source_ref = f"/assets/{asset_id}/file"
002808:     return source_ref, asset_id

003221: def _board_batch_master_audio_extra_candidates_v199g(project_id: str | None, board_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
003222:     pid = str(project_id or (board_data or {}).get("project_id") or (board_data or {}).get("projectId") or "").strip()
003223:     if not pid:
003224:         return []
003225:     try:
003226:         db = store.get_db() or {}
003227:         assets = list((db.get("assets") or {}).values()) if isinstance(db, dict) else []
003228:     except Exception:
003229:         assets = []
003230:     out: list[dict[str, str]] = []
003231:     for asset in assets:
003232:         if not isinstance(asset, dict):
003233:             continue
003234:         if str(asset.get("project_id") or asset.get("projectId") or "") != pid:
003235:             continue
003236:         kind = str(asset.get("kind") or "").lower().strip()
003237:         mime = str(asset.get("mime_type") or asset.get("mimeType") or "").lower().strip()
003238:         if kind != "audio" and not mime.startswith("audio/"):
003239:             continue
003240:         aid = str(asset.get("id") or "").strip()
003241:         if not aid:
003242:             continue
003243:         try:
003244:             path = _asset_file_path_from_record(asset)
003245:             if not path or not path.exists() or not path.is_file():
003246:                 continue
003247:         except Exception:
003248:             continue
003249:         # Keep vocal records in the list for logging/rejection, but sort them last.
003250:         out.append({
003251:             "source": "assets.db.project_audio_v199g",
003252:             "ref": f"/assets/{aid}/file",
003253:             "asset_id": aid,
003254:             "path": str(path),
003255:             "updated": str(asset.get("updated_at") or asset.get("updatedAt") or asset.get("created_at") or asset.get("createdAt") or ""),
003256:         })
003257:     out.sort(key=lambda item: (
003258:         0 if _board_batch_audio_candidate_is_vocal_only_v199g(item, Path(item.get("path") or "")) else 1,
003259:         item.get("updated") or "",
003260:     ), reverse=True)
003261:     return out

004211: # AVA_BOARD_MANUAL_QUEUE_STALE_LOCK_V200A:
004212: # Frontend/manual scene queue can leave a scene in starting/submitting/running with no job_id
004213: # when /clip/video/start fails between the UI start mark and the real backend job creation.
004214: # Clear these stale scene locks from snapshot during video-batch/status polling so a stuck
004215: # card cannot block the next manual queued scene forever.
004216: def _board_batch_parse_iso_dt_v200a(value: Any) -> datetime | None:
004217:     raw = str(value or "").strip()
004218:     if not raw:
004219:         return None
004220:     try:
004221:         if raw.endswith("Z"):
004222:             raw = raw[:-1] + "+00:00"
004223:         parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
004224:         if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
004225:             parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
004226:         return parsed
004227:     except Exception:
004228:         return None

005070: def _board_batch_cleanup_orphaned_after_reload_v150a(project_id: str, board_data: dict[str, Any], batch: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
005071:     """Clear a persisted server-batch that has no live in-memory runner after reload.
005072: 
005073:     Uvicorn --reload kills daemon batch threads. The snapshot can still say queued/running,
005074:     so the frontend keeps rendering "видео делается" / "в очереди" and refuses to POST a
005075:     new batch. If the batch is active in the snapshot but absent from BOARD_VIDEO_BATCHES,
005076:     mark it interrupted and clear transient scene job fields so the user can run again.
005077:     """
005078:     if not isinstance(batch, dict) or not batch:
005079:         return None
005080:     batch_id = str(batch.get("batchId") or batch.get("batch_id") or "").strip()
005081:     status = str(batch.get("status") or batch.get("batch_status") or "").strip().lower()
005082:     active_statuses = {"queued", "running", "starting", "preparing", "submitting", "processing", "cancel_requested"}
005083:     waiting_ids = batch.get("waitingSceneIds") or batch.get("waiting_scene_ids") or []
005084:     active_scene_id = str(batch.get("activeSceneId") or batch.get("active_scene_id") or "").strip()
005085:     active_job_id = str(batch.get("activeJobId") or batch.get("active_job_id") or "").strip()
005086:     active_endpoint = str(batch.get("activeStatusEndpoint") or batch.get("active_status_endpoint") or "").strip()
005087:     looks_active = bool(status in active_statuses or active_scene_id or active_job_id or active_endpoint or waiting_ids)
005088:     if not looks_active:
005089:         return None

006008: def _mmaudio_words(value: Any) -> set[str]:
006009:     text = str(value or "").lower()
006010:     return set(re.findall(r"[a-zа-яё0-9_]+", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE))

006013: def _mmaudio_seed_from_payload(payload_data: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
006014:     raw = _payload_get(payload_data, "mmaudio_seed", "mmaudioSeed", "seed", default="")
006015:     if str(raw or "").strip():
006016:         try:
006017:             value = int(float(raw))
006018:             if value > 0:
006019:                 return value
006020:         except Exception:
006021:             pass
006022:     # MMAudio works better for testing when each run explores a new sample.
006023:     return random.randint(1, 2_147_483_000)

006026: def _mmaudio_append_unique(base: str, extra: str) -> str:
006027:     base_text = str(base or "").strip()
006028:     extra_text = str(extra or "").strip()
006029:     if not extra_text:
006030:         return base_text
006031:     lowered = base_text.lower()
006032:     parts = []
006033:     for chunk in [item.strip() for item in extra_text.split(",") if item.strip()]:
006034:         if chunk.lower() not in lowered:
006035:             parts.append(chunk)
006036:     if not parts:
006037:         return base_text
006038:     return (base_text + ", " if base_text else "") + ", ".join(parts)

000415: def _ava_v212s2_signatures_differ(manual_data, board_data, eps=0.035):
000416:     manual_sig = _ava_v212s2_scene_signature(manual_data)
000417:     board_sig = _ava_v212s2_scene_signature(board_data)
000418:     if not manual_sig:
000419:         return False, manual_sig, board_sig
000420:     if len(manual_sig) != len(board_sig):
000421:         return True, manual_sig, board_sig
000422:     for left, right in zip(manual_sig, board_sig):
000423:         if left[0] != right[0]:
000424:             return True, manual_sig, board_sig
000425:         for i in (1, 2, 3):
000426:             if abs(float(left[i]) - float(right[i])) > eps:
000427:                 return True, manual_sig, board_sig
000428:     return False, manual_sig, board_sig

000415: def _ava_v212s2_signatures_differ(manual_data, board_data, eps=0.035):
000416:     manual_sig = _ava_v212s2_scene_signature(manual_data)
000417:     board_sig = _ava_v212s2_scene_signature(board_data)
000418:     if not manual_sig:
000419:         return False, manual_sig, board_sig
000420:     if len(manual_sig) != len(board_sig):
000421:         return True, manual_sig, board_sig
000422:     for left, right in zip(manual_sig, board_sig):
000423:         if left[0] != right[0]:
000424:             return True, manual_sig, board_sig
000425:         for i in (1, 2, 3):
000426:             if abs(float(left[i]) - float(right[i])) > eps:
000427:                 return True, manual_sig, board_sig
000428:     return False, manual_sig, board_sig

002457: # AVA_PROJECT_DIRECT_REVIEW_STATE_V136A
002458: # One final authoritative review resolver for Board.
002459: # Manual "плохое" and manual clear are compared by per-scene timestamps;
002460: # media/video refs are never touched here.
002461: def _ava_project_review_dt_v136a(value):
002462:     if not value:
002463:         return None
002464:     try:
002465:         text = str(value).strip()
002466:         if not text:
002467:             return None
002468:         if text.endswith("Z"):
002469:             text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
002470:         return datetime.fromisoformat(text)
002471:     except Exception:
002472:         return None

002136: def _telegram_get_updates_once(timeout_sec: int = 2) -> dict[str, Any]:
002137:     if not _telegram_token():
002138:         return {"ok": False, "error": "telegram_token_missing"}
002139:     # AVA_TELEGRAM_POLL_NO_WRITE_ON_IDLE_V200F:
002140:     # Reading the Telegram offset is a GET-like operation. The old code used
002141:     # store.update() just to read offset, which rewrote ava_db.json on every
002142:     # background poll and locked the JSON store while the UI was loading Board.
002143:     try:
002144:         db_for_offset_v200f = store.get_db()
002145:         state_v200f = db_for_offset_v200f.get("telegram_poll_state_v137a") or {}
002146:         offset = int(state_v200f.get("offset") or 0)
002147:     except Exception as exc:
002148:         print("[TELEGRAM POLL OFFSET READ FALLBACK V200F]", {"error": str(exc)}, flush=True)
002149:         offset = 0
002150:     params = {"timeout": str(max(0, int(timeout_sec))), "allowed_updates": json.dumps(["message", "callback_query"])}
002151:     if offset:
002152:         params["offset"] = str(offset)
002153:     url = _api_url("getUpdates") + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
002154:     try:
002155:         with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=max(5, timeout_sec + 5)) as resp:
002156:             raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
002157:             data = json.loads(raw or "{}")
002158:     except Exception as exc:
002159:         print("[TELEGRAM POLL ERROR V137A]", {"error": str(exc)}, flush=True)
002160:         return {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}
002161:     results = data.get("result") if isinstance(data, dict) else []
002162:     processed = []
002163:     max_update_id = offset - 1 if offset else -1
002164:     for update in results or []:
002165:         if not isinstance(update, dict):
002166:             continue
002167:         update_id = int(update.get("update_id") or 0)
002168:         max_update_id = max(max_update_id, update_id)
002169:         processed.append(_process_update(update))
002170:     next_offset_v200f = max_update_id + 1 if max_update_id >= 0 else offset
002171:     if max_update_id >= 0 and next_offset_v200f != offset:
002172:         def save_offset(db: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
002173:             state = db.setdefault("telegram_poll_state_v137a", {})
002174:             state["offset"] = next_offset_v200f
002175:             state["updated_at"] = now_iso()
002176:             return state
002177:         store.update(save_offset)
002178:     elif max_update_id >= 0:
002179:         print("[TELEGRAM POLL OFFSET WRITE SKIPPED V200F]", {"offset": offset, "count": len(results or [])}, flush=True)
002180:     return {"ok": bool(data.get("ok")) if isinstance(data, dict) else False, "count": len(results or []), "processed": processed}

002075: def _process_update(update: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
002076:     try:
002077:         callback = update.get("callback_query") if isinstance(update, dict) else None
002078:         if isinstance(callback, dict):
002079:             callback_id = str(callback.get("id") or "")
002080:             data = str(callback.get("data") or "")
002081:             message = callback.get("message") if isinstance(callback.get("message"), dict) else {}
002082:             chat = message.get("chat") if isinstance(message.get("chat"), dict) else {}
002083:             chat_id = str(chat.get("id") or "")
002084:             message_id = message.get("message_id") or ""
002085:             if _telegram_chat_id() and chat_id != _telegram_chat_id():
002086:                 _answer_callback(callback_id, "Этот chat_id не разрешён", True)

000179: # AVA_VIDEO_NODE_HARD_CLEAR_SNAPSHOT_GUARD_V209B
000180: # A Video Node manual clear must beat old in-flight autosaves/hydration restores.
000181: # The clear stores a small tombstone snapshot. Later safe_merge saves whose updatedAt/importedAt
000182: # is older than the clear are rejected, so the old source video/layout cannot resurrect.

000758:     const liveEndpoint = String(scene.video_status_endpoint || scene.videoStatusEndpoint || scene.status_endpoint || scene.statusEndpoint || '').trim()
000759:     const status = String(scene.video_status || scene.videoStatus || scene.status || '').toLowerCase()
000760:     const active = new Set(['queued', 'running', 'starting', 'preparing', 'submitting', 'processing', 'queued_no_prompt_id'])
000761: 
000762:     if (liveJobId && liveJobId !== safeJobId) return true
000763:     if (liveEndpoint && !liveEndpoint.includes(safeJobId)) return true
000764:     if (active.has(status) && !liveJobId && !liveEndpoint) return true
000765:

000767:       scene.video_asset_id || scene.videoAssetId ||

000772:       scene.result_video_url || scene.resultVideoUrl

000775:     // probably an old global job finishing late. Do not let it overwrite server-batch result.
000776:     if (hasReadyVideo && !liveJobId && !liveEndpoint) return true
000777:     return false

000780:   async function persistFinishedJobToBoardSnapshot(job, data) {
000781:     const sceneId = job?.sceneId || ''
000782:     if (!sceneId) return
000783: 
000784:     const patch = job.kind === 'mmaudio'
000785:       ? mmaudioPatchFromJobData(data, job)
000786:       : videoPatchFromJobData(data, job)
000787: 
000788:     const hasResult = job.kind === 'mmaudio'
000789:       ? Boolean(patch.mmaudio_video_url)
000790:       : Boolean(patch.video_url)
000791: 
000792:     if (!hasResult) return
000793: 
000794:     const endpoint = boardSnapshotEndpointForJob(job)
000795: 
000796:     try {
000797:       const current = await apiRequest(endpoint)
000798:       const boardData = current?.snapshot?.data || {}
000799:       const scenes = Array.isArray(boardData.scenes) ? boardData.scenes : []
000800: 
000801:       if (String(job?.stage || '').toLowerCase() === 'board' && job.kind !== 'mmaudio' && avaShellBoardBatchIsActiveV209Q(boardData)) {
000802:         console.log('[AVA SHELL BOARD JOB PERSIST SKIPPED V209Q]', {
000803:           reason: 'active_server_batch',
000804:           projectId: job?.projectId || '',
000805:           sceneId,
000806:           jobId: job?.jobId || job?.job_id || '',
000807:         })
000808:         return
000809:       }
000810: 
000811:       const targetSceneV209Q = scenes.find((scene) => (scene?.id || scene?.scene_id) === sceneId) || null
000812:       if (String(job?.stage || '').toLowerCase() === 'board' && job.kind !== 'mmaudio' && avaShellBoardSceneRejectsJobV209Q(targetSceneV209Q, job?.jobId || job?.job_id || '')) {
000813:         console.log('[AVA SHELL BOARD JOB PERSIST SKIPPED V209Q]', {
000814:           reason: 'scene_does_not_accept_job',
000815:           projectId: job?.projectId || '',
000816:           sceneId,
000817:           jobId: job?.jobId || job?.job_id || '',
000818:           liveJobId: targetSceneV209Q?.video_job_id || targetSceneV209Q?.videoJobId || '',
000819:           liveEndpoint: targetSceneV209Q?.video_status_endpoint || targetSceneV209Q?.videoStatusEndpoint || '',
000820:         })
000821:         return
000822:       }
000823: 
000824:       let changed = false
000825:       const nextScenes = scenes.map((scene) => {
000826:         const id = scene?.id || scene?.scene_id
000827:         if (id !== sceneId) return scene
000828: 
000829:         changed = true
000830:         return {
000831:           ...scene,
000832:           ...patch,
000833:         }
000834:       })
000835: 
000836:       if (!changed) return
000837: 
000838:       const nextBoard = {
000839:         ...boardData,
000840:         scenes: nextScenes,
000841:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
000842:       }
000843: 
000844:       await apiRequest(endpoint, {
000845:         method: 'POST',
000846:         body: JSON.stringify({
000847:           data: nextBoard,
000848:           guard_mode: endpoint.startsWith('/workspace/') ? 'replace' : 'safe_merge',
000849:           client_version: 'ava-shell-global-job-v1',
000850:         }),
000851:       })
000852:     } catch (error) {
000853:       console.warn('[AvaShell] failed to persist finished job to Board snapshot', error)
000854:     }
000855:   }

001467:   const acceptedAt = String(scene?.video_review_accepted_at || scene?.videoReviewAcceptedAt || '').trim()

001492: function boardLocalReviewEventWinsV213L(localScene = {}, serverScene = {}) {
001493:   const localEvent = boardReviewEventInfoV213L(localScene)
001494:   if (!localEvent.has) return false
001495:   const serverEvent = boardReviewEventInfoV213L(serverScene)
001496:   if (!serverEvent.has) return true
001497:   if (localEvent.atMs && serverEvent.atMs) return localEvent.atMs >= serverEvent.atMs
001498:   if (localEvent.manual && !serverEvent.manual) return true
001499:   return false

002549: function formatTime(seconds) {
002550:   const safe = Math.max(0, toNumber(seconds, 0))
002551:   const mins = String(Math.floor(safe / 60)).padStart(2, '0')
002552:   const secs = String(Math.floor(safe % 60)).padStart(2, '0')
002553:   const ms = String(Math.floor((safe - Math.floor(safe)) * 1000)).padStart(3, '0')
002554:   return `${mins}:${secs}.${ms}`
002555: }

005450: function boardTimingComparableSceneV212S(scene = {}, index = 0) {
005451:   const id = asText(scene.scene_id || scene.id || `seg_${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`)
005452:   const start = toNumber(scene.start_sec ?? scene.start ?? scene.target_t0 ?? scene.t0, 0)
005453:   const rawEnd = toNumber(scene.end_sec ?? scene.end ?? scene.target_t1 ?? scene.t1, NaN)
005454:   const rawDuration = toNumber(scene.duration_sec ?? scene.durationSec ?? scene.duration, NaN)
005455:   const duration = Number((Number.isFinite(rawDuration) ? rawDuration : Math.max(0, rawEnd - start)).toFixed(3))
005456:   const end = Number((Number.isFinite(rawEnd) ? rawEnd : start + duration).toFixed(3))
005457:   return { id, start: Number(start.toFixed ? start.toFixed(3) : Number(start).toFixed(3)), end, duration }
005458: }

001986: function normalizeBlocks(blocks = [], fallbackDurationSec = 0, savedClipsForMigration = []) {
001987:   const normalized = (Array.isArray(blocks) ? blocks : [])
001988:     .map((block, index) => {
001989:       const start = roundSeconds(block?.source_start_sec);
001990:       const end = roundSeconds(block?.source_end_sec);
001991:       if (end <= start) return null;
001992:       const savedClipMatch = (Array.isArray(savedClipsForMigration) ? savedClipsForMigration : [])
001993:         .find((clip) => String(clip?.id || "") && String(clip?.id || "") === String(block?.inserted_phrase_id || block?.saved_clip_id || block?.phrase_id || ""));
001994:       const migratedLabel = getStoredBlockLabel(block) || String(savedClipMatch?.label || "").trim();
001995:       const phraseIdentity = hasPhraseIdentity(block) || Boolean(savedClipMatch);
001996:       const type = block?.type === "silence" ? "silence" : (phraseIdentity ? "phrase" : (block?.type || "audio"));
001997:       return {
001998:         id: String(block?.id || `block_${index}`),
001999:         type,
002000:         block_kind: phraseIdentity ? "phrase" : undefined,
002001:         source_audio_id: block?.source_audio_id || (type === "silence" ? "silence" : "main"),
002002:         source_kind: type === "silence" ? "silence" : (phraseIdentity ? "inserted_audio" : (block?.source_kind || "main_audio")),
002003:         block_type: type === "silence" ? "silence" : (phraseIdentity ? "inserted_audio" : (block?.block_type || "main_audio")),
002004:         source_url: typeof block?.source_url === "string" && block.source_url.trim() ? block.source_url.trim() : undefined,
002005:         audio_url: typeof block?.audio_url === "string" && block.audio_url.trim() ? block.audio_url.trim() : undefined,
002006:         fragment_url: typeof block?.fragment_url === "string" && block.fragment_url.trim() ? block.fragment_url.trim() : undefined,
002007:         asset_url: typeof block?.asset_url === "string" && block.asset_url.trim() ? block.asset_url.trim() : undefined,
002008:         assetUrl: typeof block?.assetUrl === "string" && block.assetUrl.trim() ? block.assetUrl.trim() : undefined,
002009:         server_url: typeof block?.server_url === "string" && block.server_url.trim() ? block.server_url.trim() : undefined,
002010:         publicUrl: typeof block?.publicUrl === "string" && block.publicUrl.trim() ? block.publicUrl.trim() : undefined,
002011:         src: typeof block?.src === "string" && block.src.trim() ? block.src.trim() : undefined,
002012:         source_name: typeof block?.source_name === "string" && block.source_name.trim() ? block.source_name.trim() : undefined,
002013:         duration_sec: phraseIdentity ? roundSeconds(block?.duration_sec || end - start) : undefined,
002014:         source_start_sec: type === "silence" ? 0 : (phraseIdentity ? 0 : start),
002015:         source_end_sec: type === "silence" ? roundSeconds(end - start) : (phraseIdentity ? roundSeconds(block?.duration_sec || end - start) : end),
002016:         color_index: Number.isInteger(block?.color_index) ? block.color_index : index,
002017:         color: typeof block?.color === "string" && block.color.trim() ? block.color.trim() : undefined,
002018:         block_label: migratedLabel || undefined,
002019:         phrase_label: phraseIdentity && migratedLabel ? migratedLabel : undefined,
002020:         inserted_phrase_label: phraseIdentity && migratedLabel ? migratedLabel : undefined,
002021:         saved_clip_label: phraseIdentity && migratedLabel ? migratedLabel : undefined,
002022:         inserted_phrase_id: block?.inserted_phrase_id || block?.saved_clip_id || block?.phrase_id || savedClipMatch?.id || undefined,
002023:         saved_clip_id: block?.saved_clip_id || block?.inserted_phrase_id || block?.phrase_id || savedClipMatch?.id || undefined,
002024:       };
002025:     })
002026:     .filter(Boolean);
002027:   return normalized.length ? normalized : createInitialBlocks(fallbackDurationSec);
002028: }

002740:   deletionMarkers = [],
002741:   onSeek,
002742:   onSelectBlock,
002743:   onBlockDoubleClick,
002744: }) {
002745:   const safeDuration = Math.max(0, normalizeNumber(totalDurationSec, 0));
002746:   const playheadLeft = safeDuration > 0 ? `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (currentTimeSec / safeDuration) * 100))}%` : "0%";
002747: 
002748:   return (
002749:     <div className="podcastBlockTimelineWrap">
002750:       <div
002751:         className="podcastBlockTimeline"
002752:         role="button"
002753:         tabIndex={0}
002754:         aria-label="Блочная аудио-дорожка"
002755:         onClick={(event) => {
002756:           if (!safeDuration || !onSeek) return;
002757:           const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
002758:           const ratio = rect.width > 0 ? (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width : 0;
002759:           onSeek(clampSeconds(ratio * safeDuration, 0, safeDuration));
002760:         }}
002761:       >
002762:         {blocks.map((block, index) => {
002763:           const duration = getBlockDuration(block);
002764:           const startSec = getBlockVirtualStart(blocks, index);
002765:           const widthPercent = safeDuration > 0 ? `${(duration / safeDuration) * 100}%` : "0%";
002766:           const leftPercent = safeDuration > 0 ? `${(startSec / safeDuration) * 100}%` : "0%";
002767:           const isSelected = block.id === selectedBlockId;
002768:           const isDeletingBlockV168A = String(block.id || "") === String(deletingBlockId || "");
002769:           const color = getBlockRenderColor(block);
002770:           const badgeText = getBlockInitialText(block);
002771:           const labelText = getBlockLabelText(block);
002772:           return (
002773:             <div
002774:               key={block.id}
002775:               className={`podcastAudioBlock${isSelected ? " selected" : ""}${isDeletingBlockV168A ? " isDeletingV168A" : ""}${block.type === "silence" ? " silence" : ""}${(block.source_audio_id || "main") === "main" && block.type !== "silence" && !hasPhraseIdentity(block) && !getStoredBlockLabel(block) ? " narrator" : ""}${hasPhraseIdentity(block) ? " phrase" : ""}${badgeText ? " labeled" : ""}`}
002776:               style={{ left: leftPercent, width: widthPercent, "--block-color": color }}
002777:               onClick={(event) => {
002778:                 event.stopPropagation();
002779:                 onSelectBlock?.(block.id, startSec);
002780:               }}
002781:               onDoubleClick={(event) => {
002782:                 event.stopPropagation();
002783:                 onBlockDoubleClick?.(block.id, startSec, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
002784:               }}
002785:               title={`${labelText ? `${labelText} · ` : ""}${formatTimer(startSec)} → ${formatTimer(startSec + duration)} · двойной клик = меню`}
002786:             >
002787:               {badgeText ? <span className="podcastBlockBadge" title={labelText}>{badgeText}</span> : null}
002788:               {isDeletingBlockV168A ? <span className="podcastDeleteProgressV168A" aria-label="Удаляем аудио-блок"><i /><b>🗑</b></span> : null}
002789:             </div>
002790:           );
002791:         })}
002792: 
002793:         {deletionMarkers.map((marker) => {
002794:           const left = safeDuration > 0 ? `${(roundSeconds(marker.at_sec) / safeDuration) * 100}%` : "0%";
002795:           return <div key={marker.id} className="podcastDeleteCutMark" style={{ left }} title={`Удалено ${formatTimer(marker.removed_duration_sec)}`} />;
002796:         })}
002797: 
002798:         <div className="podcastPlayhead" style={{ left: playheadLeft }}>
002799:           <span>{formatTimer(currentTimeSec)}</span>
002800:         </div>
002801:       </div>
002802:     </div>
002803:   );

000631: function migratePodcastStoredAudioUrls(value, depth = 0) {
000632:   if (depth > 16) return value;
000633:   if (typeof value === "string") {
000634:     return value.includes("localhost:8000") || value.startsWith("/static/assets/") || /^\/(?:api\/)?assets\/[^/]+\/file/i.test(value)
000635:       ? normalizePodcastAudioSourceUrl(value)
000636:       : value;
000637:   }
000638:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return value;
000639:   if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => migratePodcastStoredAudioUrls(item, depth + 1));
000640:   const out = {};
000641:   Object.entries(value).forEach(([key, item]) => {
000642:     out[key] = migratePodcastStoredAudioUrls(item, depth + 1);
000643:   });
000644:   return out;
000645: }

001491: async function saveGeneratorHandoffAssemblySnapshot(board = {}, projectId = '') {

001494:   // computer opens the same scene list without relying on browser localStorage.

001596: function generatorAssetIdFromRef(...values) {

001603:   }
001604:   return ''
001605: }

001303: function validateAssembleAudioPath(rawPath = "") {
001304:   const value = String(rawPath || "").trim();
001305:   if (!value) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_REQUIRED" };
001306:   if (value.endsWith("...")) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_TRUNCATED" };
001307:   const lowered = value.toLowerCase();
001308:   if (lowered.startsWith("blob:") || lowered.startsWith("http://") || lowered.startsWith("https://") || lowered.startsWith("data:")) {
001309:     return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_PREVIEW_ONLY" };
001310:   }
001311:   const looksLikeAbsolutePath = /^([a-zA-Z]:[\\/]|\/|~\/)/.test(value);
001312:   if (!looksLikeAbsolutePath) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_LOCAL" };
001313:   if (!AUDIO_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => lowered.endsWith(ext))) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_INVALID_EXT" };
001314:   return { ok: true, code: "OK" };
001315: }

001301: const AUDIO_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS = [".mp3", ".wav", ".m4a", ".aac", ".flac", ".ogg"];
001302: 
001303: function validateAssembleAudioPath(rawPath = "") {
001304:   const value = String(rawPath || "").trim();
001305:   if (!value) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_REQUIRED" };
001306:   if (value.endsWith("...")) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_TRUNCATED" };
001307:   const lowered = value.toLowerCase();
001308:   if (lowered.startsWith("blob:") || lowered.startsWith("http://") || lowered.startsWith("https://") || lowered.startsWith("data:")) {
001309:     return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_PREVIEW_ONLY" };
001310:   }
001311:   const looksLikeAbsolutePath = /^([a-zA-Z]:[\\/]|\/|~\/)/.test(value);
001312:   if (!looksLikeAbsolutePath) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_LOCAL" };
001313:   if (!AUDIO_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => lowered.endsWith(ext))) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_INVALID_EXT" };
001314:   return { ok: true, code: "OK" };
001315: }

001317: function resolveAssembleApiErrorMessage(error) {
001318:   const code = String(
001319:     error?.code
001320:     || error?.detail?.code
001321:     || error?.payload?.code
001322:     || error?.payload?.detail?.code
001323:     || error?.response?.code
001324:     || error?.response?.detail?.code
001325:     || "",
001326:   ).trim();
001327:   if (code === "AUDIO_PATH_REQUIRED") return "Загрузите аудио через +Аудио: файл должен сохраниться на backend для MP4-сборки.";
001328:   if (code === "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_FOUND") return "Файл не найден по указанному пути к аудио.";
001329:   if (code === "AUDIO_PATH_INVALID_EXT") return "Неподдерживаемый формат аудио. Используйте .mp3, .wav, .m4a или .aac.";
001330:   if (["AUDIO_PATH_PREVIEW_ONLY", "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_LOCAL", "AUDIO_PATH_TRUNCATED"].includes(code)) {
001331:     return "Аудио не готово для MP4. Нажмите +Аудио ещё раз, чтобы файл загрузился на backend.";
001332:   }
001333:   return String(error?.message || error || "Не удалось собрать MP4");
001334: }

001347: function computeImportCompatibilityScore(currentProject = {}, incoming = {}) {
001348:   const currentSegments = Array.isArray(currentProject?.matchSegments) ? currentProject.matchSegments.length : 0;
001349:   const incomingSegments = Array.isArray(incoming?.matchSegments) ? incoming.matchSegments.length : 0;
001350:   const currentVideoDuration = Number(currentProject?.sourceVideo?.duration_sec || 0);
001351:   const incomingVideoDuration = Number(incoming?.sourceVideo?.duration_sec || 0);
001352:   const currentAudioDuration = Number(currentProject?.audioPreviewMeta?.duration_sec || currentProject?.timingContext?.audioDurationSec || 0);
001353:   const incomingAudioDuration = Number(incoming?.timingContext?.audioDurationSec || 0);
001354:   const durationDelta = Math.abs(currentVideoDuration - incomingVideoDuration);
001355:   const audioDelta = Math.abs(currentAudioDuration - incomingAudioDuration);
001356:   const segmentDelta = Math.abs(currentSegments - incomingSegments);
001357:   return {
001358:     currentSegments, incomingSegments, currentVideoDuration, incomingVideoDuration,
001359:     currentAudioDuration, incomingAudioDuration,
001360:     mismatch: segmentDelta >= 3 || durationDelta > 10 || audioDelta > 10,
001361:   };
001362: }

001303: function validateAssembleAudioPath(rawPath = "") {
001304:   const value = String(rawPath || "").trim();
001305:   if (!value) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_REQUIRED" };
001306:   if (value.endsWith("...")) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_TRUNCATED" };
001307:   const lowered = value.toLowerCase();
001308:   if (lowered.startsWith("blob:") || lowered.startsWith("http://") || lowered.startsWith("https://") || lowered.startsWith("data:")) {
001309:     return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_PREVIEW_ONLY" };
001310:   }
001311:   const looksLikeAbsolutePath = /^([a-zA-Z]:[\\/]|\/|~\/)/.test(value);
001312:   if (!looksLikeAbsolutePath) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_LOCAL" };
001313:   if (!AUDIO_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => lowered.endsWith(ext))) return { ok: false, code: "AUDIO_PATH_INVALID_EXT" };
001314:   return { ok: true, code: "OK" };
001315: }

001321:     || error?.payload?.code
001322:     || error?.payload?.detail?.code
001323:     || error?.response?.code
001324:     || error?.response?.detail?.code
001325:     || "",
001326:   ).trim();

001328:   if (code === "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_FOUND") return "Файл не найден по указанному пути к аудио.";
001329:   if (code === "AUDIO_PATH_INVALID_EXT") return "Неподдерживаемый формат аудио. Используйте .mp3, .wav, .m4a или .aac.";
001330:   if (["AUDIO_PATH_PREVIEW_ONLY", "AUDIO_PATH_NOT_LOCAL", "AUDIO_PATH_TRUNCATED"].includes(code)) {
001331:     return "Аудио не готово для MP4. Нажмите +Аудио ещё раз, чтобы файл загрузился на backend.";
001332:   }
001333:   return String(error?.message || error || "Не удалось собрать MP4");
